title: calliope_read_container — the answer
description: A container's blocks in position order; a block whose prose is absent is dangling with null text. asOfTx echoes an as-of read. A placement block also carries ref {slot, container}; a placements read adds placements to each block; an orphaned placement reads dangling with ref kept. An unknown container answers an empty block list. A refusal is NOT described here: it is an isError result {code, detail} (refusal.schema.json), and its code is in contracts/refusal-codes.toml.

facts.description: The slot's facts (only on a facts read); form says whether each is a node token or a literal placeholder.

ref.description: Present only on a placement (a slot that places another slot): the origin slot it resolves through, and the container holding that origin. container is present on current reads only, never on an as_of_tx read. blobId and text are the origin's; an orphaned placement keeps its ref and reads dangling. Absent on every blob slot.

placements.description: Present only on a placements read: the slots placing this one (empty on an ordinary block).

container.description: Absent when no container holds the placement.
